findings.quote: -        let written = "no flock at /tmp/x\n  to set up a flock there deliberately: mkdir -p /tmp/x";
findings.what: The old convention was caller-owned indentation, but this commit touches no call site, so any production message still carrying its own "\n  " continuation (the flock refusal, refuse_version_skew, toml_edit's "  |" gutter lines) now renders with four spaces in table mode.

findings.quote: +        let written = "no flock at /tmp/x\nto set up a flock there deliberately: mkdir -p /tmp/x";
findings.what: Dropping the two spaces from the test input changes the error_multiline_json snapshot (the JSON message no longer contains the indent) yet the commit includes no updated .snap file, so the insta test fails.
A whitespace-only continuation line is not empty, so it is indented and emits trailing whitespace on what reads as a blank line, contrary to the documented guarantee.
